home.title: -60° Solo Helper
home.play1: Play a -60° solo game against Arka.
home.play2: This application manages Arka's Action Cards, Arka's Milestone Cards and Arka's Tableau and guides you through the game and solo ruleset. It supports all difficulty levels.

difficultyLevel.title: Difficulty Level
difficultyLevel.actionCardsWithoutStar: no Action Cards without a star | {count} Action Card without a star | {count} Action Cards without a star

instructions.twoPlayerSetup: Follow the normal setup for a two player game. Also, complete the personal setup until step 12.
instructions.milestoneCards: Take 4 Milestone Cards at random. Choose 3 of them and place them above the Expert Plan. Place the fourth Milestone Card back in the box, as it won't be needed.
instructions.arkaTableau: Take Arka's Tableau. It is only used to place the Experts Arka takes in its three Expert columns. The Expedition Path, Expedition Track, Rondel and Upgrades are managed by the app.
instructions.arkaComponents: Choose a color for Arka. Place the 4 personal Station Sites and 5 Stations of this color next to her Tableau. Take all Explorers of this color and place 2 of them back in the box.
instructions.arkaCards: Leave some space to the left of Arka's Tableau for the Cards she draws face down.
instructions.arkaMilestoneCards: Arka's Milestone Cards, scored from left to right. Optionally, place them below her Tableau:

ruleChanges.title: Managed by the App
ruleChanges.managedByApp: Arka's Action Cards and her Milestone scoring are managed by the app. You do not need the Expedition Marker, Energy Marker, Milestone Tiles and Upgrades of Arka's color, nor the Starting Indicator.
ruleChanges.actionCardDeck: Arka's Action Card deck consists of all 9 Action Cards with one star and no Action Cards without a star. | Arka's Action Card deck consists of all 9 Action Cards with one star and {count} random Action Card without a star. | Arka's Action Card deck consists of all 9 Action Cards with one star and {count} random Action Cards without a star.
ruleChanges.arkaPhases: Arka does not perform a Preparation and a Planning Phase. She is only active during the Action Phase and scores Milestones at the end of the third, fifth and sixth round.
ruleChanges.firstPlayer: You are the first player in round 1.
ruleChanges.meteorite: Arka ignores the Meteorite. She never places an Explorer on it and scores no victory points from it.

roundStart.title: Round {round}

startPlayer.player: You are the start player in this round.
startPlayer.bot: Arka is the start player in this round.

planning.title: II. Planning
planning.takeExplorers: Take 2 Explorers from the general supply and place them on your Reserve.
planning.drawCards: Draw 5 Cards from the common deck. Keep one of them for free or spend two Energy to keep two Cards.

roundStart.arkaSkipsPhases: Arka does not perform a Preparation and a Planning Phase.
roundStart.milestoneRound: At the end of this round, you and Arka score a Milestone.

roundTurnPlayer.title: Your Turn
roundTurnPlayer.execute: On your turn, you must perform exactly one action or pass.
roundTurnPlayer.passConfirm: Pass and drop out of the Action Phase?
roundTurnPlayer.passInfo: Place all Storm and Expedition Cards from your Tableau on your personal discard pile. You can bring one unused Explorer to the next round.

roundTurnBot.title: Arka
roundTurnBot.revealActionCard: Arka reveals her next Action Card and carries out the actions from top to bottom:
roundTurnBot.pass: Arka has already played the {count} stars of her Expedition Level in this round, so she passes.

roundEnd.title: End of Round {round}
roundEnd.scoreMilestone: Milestone: Choose which Milestone Card you want to score. Place your Milestone Tile with the correct side face up on the Milestone Card. You may not score this Milestone Card again.
roundEnd.moveRoundIndicator: Move the Round Indicator one space forward.
